# package svops

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/iec61850ctl/pkg/svops"
```

Package svops implements the iec61850ctl Sampled Values commands on top of github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/sv: listing control blocks from SCL, sniffing and subscribing to SV streams, publishing (including 9-2LE waveform injection), and rendering ASDUs and stream statistics as text or JSON Lines.

## Variables

```go
var LEChannels = [8]string{"IA", "IB", "IC", "IN", "VA", "VB", "VC", "VN"}
```

LEChannels are the 9-2LE channel names in dataset order.

### func IsLE

```go
func IsLE(layout sv.Layout) bool
```

IsLE reports whether layout is the UCA 9-2LE dataset (four currents and four voltages, each INT32 + Quality).

### func LeafNames

```go
func LeafNames(cb *sv.ControlBlock) [][]string
```

LeafNames returns the names a --value can address each leaf of cb's layout by, besides its index: the member reference for single-leaf members, REF#N for leaf N of a structured member, and for the 9-2LE dataset the channel names (IA ... VN) and their qualities (qIA ... qVN).

### func LoadControlBlocks

```go
func LoadControlBlocks(path string) (cbs []sv.ControlBlock, warning error, err error)
```

LoadControlBlocks parses an SCL file and resolves every SampledValueControl block. Blocks that cannot be resolved are reported through the returned warning (nil when all resolved); a parse failure is an error.

### func OptFldsNames

```go
func OptFldsNames(o sv.OptFlds) []string
```

OptFldsNames lists the set optional fields.

### func ParseKindValue

```go
func ParseKindValue(raw string, k sv.Kind) (*mms.Value, error)
```

ParseKindValue parses raw as a value of the sample encoding k:

  - BOOLEAN: true/false
  - INT\*, INT\*U, ENUM: integers (range-checked when encoded)
  - FLOAT32/FLOAT64: numbers
  - Dbpos: intermediate, off, on, bad or 0-3
  - Quality: good, invalid, questionable, test, joined with "+" ("invalid+test"); a 32-bit word ("0x0802"); or 13 MSB-first binary digits as in the MMS value JSON ("0000000000010")
  - Timestamp: "now" or RFC 3339

### func ParseLayout

```go
func ParseLayout(s string) (sv.Layout, error)
```

ParseLayout parses a sample layout: "9-2LE" for the UCA 9-2LE dataset or a comma-separated list of leaf encodings as printed by sv list ("FLOAT32,Quality,INT32U").

### func ParseOptFlds

```go
func ParseOptFlds(s string) (sv.OptFlds, error)
```

ParseOptFlds parses a comma-separated list of optional field names (refresh-time, sample-synchronized, sample-rate, data-set, security); "none" or an empty string clears all.

### func ParseQuality

```go
func ParseQuality(s string) (sv.Quality, error)
```

ParseQuality parses a quality: names joined with "+" (good, invalid, questionable, test, derived, old-data, substituted, failure, operator-blocked), a 32-bit word in hex or decimal ("0x0802"), or 13 MSB-first binary digits ("0000000000010" = test).

### func ParseSmpMod

```go
func ParseSmpMod(s string) (sv.SmpMod, error)
```

ParseSmpMod accepts the SCL names (SmpPerPeriod, SmpPerSec, SecPerSmp), the iec61850-interop names (samples-per-period, samples-per-second, seconds-per-sample) and 0-2.

### func SelectControlBlock

```go
func SelectControlBlock(cbs []sv.ControlBlock, sel string) (*sv.ControlBlock, error)
```

SelectControlBlock finds a control block by name ("MSVCB01"), LD and name ("LD0/MSVCB01"), IED, LD and name ("IED1/LD0/MSVCB01"), or its reference in either the on-wire form ("IED1LD0/LLN0$MS$MSVCB01") or the bare-LD form ("LD0/LLN0$MS$MSVCB01"). An ambiguous name is an error.

### func WaveformSource

```go
func WaveformSource(base []*mms.Value, waves []Waveform, samplesPerSecond float64) (func(sv.SampleInfo, []byte) []byte, error)
```

WaveformSource returns a 9-2LE sample source: base gives the static value and quality of every channel (16 leaves in LELayout order) and each waveform replaces one channel's value with a sine sampled at samplesPerSecond. Time is the sample index divided by the rate, so the signal is exact regardless of scheduling jitter.

#### func ViewASDU

```go
func ViewASDU(ev string, f *sv.Frame, a *sv.ASDU, i int, layout sv.Layout, lost int, rx time.Time) ASDUView
```

ViewASDU renders ASDU a, at position i of frame f, received at rx. With a layout the sample is decoded into values (and, for 9-2LE, physical units); without one it is shown as hex. f.PDU.ASDUs may be empty (the subscriber's owned copies drop it); the count comes from f.PDU.NoASDU.

#### func Subscribe

```go
func Subscribe(ctx context.Context, cfg SubscribeConfig) (StatsView, error)
```

Subscribe receives SV through a supervised subscription. It prints every supervision event (start, gap, timeout, ...), every SampleEvery-th ASDU and the stream statistics each StatsInterval, until Count ASDUs were accepted, the duration elapsed or ctx is done, then prints and returns the final statistics. An error matching errs.ErrTimeout means Count was not reached in time.

### type Waveform

```go
type Waveform struct {
	Channel   int // 0-7 in LEChannels order
	Amplitude float64
	Frequency float64 // Hz
	Phase     float64 // degrees
}
```

Waveform is a sine on one 9-2LE channel: Amplitude is the peak value in amperes (IA-IN) or volts (VA-VN).

#### func ParseWaveform

```go
func ParseWaveform(spec string, nominalHz float64) (Waveform, error)
```

ParseWaveform parses CHANNEL=AMPLITUDE\[,FREQUENCY\[,PHASE]] with the frequency in Hz (default nominalHz) and the phase in degrees (default 0), e.g. "IA=100", "VB=325,50,-120".
